text:
Lena Kim: Heads-up: running a "Spot Awards Pop-up" next Tue noon-2pm near 4th floor kitchen. Need someone to collect plaques and help with taxable payout questions. Who's available to pick plaques up Mon?
Marcus Hale: I can swing by the vendor Mon afternoon. Which mailroom?
Lena Kim: Mailroom B, package ID P-78. Please bring a tote or box for transport.
Olga Rivera: I can do the staffing 12-2 on Tue and handle the scanner/Google folder for submissions. Do we have printed nomination slips?
Lena Kim: Yes — 80 printed slips requested. Also we want a short checklist for managers so submissions include: recipient name, short blurb, manager sign-off, payout vs gift card choice.
PayrollBot: Payroll note: Spot awards are taxable. Use expense code SPOTPOP-2026 and submit PAY_REQ within 3 business days. Gift cards treated as cash-equivalent. See: https://redwood.internal/payroll/policy
Marcus Hale: Noted. I'll pick up plaques Mon 3:30pm and upload receipts after pickup.
Olga Rivera: I'll assemble a one-page checklist and add to the calendar event. Who can create the event?
Lena Kim: I'll create event tonight and attach checklist + drive folder. Reminder: volunteers should submit any pickup expenses within 7 days.
Marcus Hale: I'll bring a hand truck just in case.
Lena Kim: Great, thank you all. I'll post a final reminder Tue 9am.
